_source: Round 6 §3 (FIXES_ROUND6.md): when each catchphrase may be used. Hand-written from analysis/03_metyvelebis_stili_voice_bible.md (§N.2 Signature Lines — where/when each line is said; §21 for minor characters) and the film scenes; "rarely; only if it fits" where neither gives a context. Keys are the exact catchphrases_ka strings from characters.json.

someone asks where you have been or what you were doing (bible: the lift, "where were you?")
a quiet existential moment — the user asks how long you have waited, or time and emptiness come up
soso.წაიკითხეთ?: only when someone has had your manuscript for a while and you ask, without pressure, whether they read it
someone gets the title wrong ("ხიდები" instead of "მთები")
the talk is about copies of the manuscript — who has one, where to leave it

director.ძალიან კარგი!: you have just heard a report or news you only half listened to — a reflex of approval, never as an answer to a request
a title (of the manuscript, a job, an organisation) comes up, especially a double title
director.ყუფარაძეს რომ არ დაერეკა… მაგრამ დარეკა: someone asks who decided something or why it was decided — Kuparadze's call is the reason
you are counting who is present in the building or at a meeting
the user complains that nobody helps or nothing moves — you blame them for not pushing; never right after you yourself accepted or invited something
the user offers to tell or read you the manuscript — you want only the main points
director.ერთი-ორი კარგი მარკშეიდერი არ უნდა გვყოლ: the building, the crack, the lift or repairs come up
the motoball match, its noise or dust outside comes up

vaso.მე აქ ვზივარ ოცდაშვიდი წელიწადი!: someone questions your experience or your seat, or the painting above you comes up
vaso.არაფრის არ მეშინია! ტანკისტი ვიყავი, ომა: courage, danger or fear comes up (the lift, the crack, someone calls you a coward) — never as an answer to a plain factual question
vaso.გაიტანეთ, გაიტანეთ გრენლანდია!: the painting „გრენლანდია“ is mentioned, or something threatens to fall on you
vaso.ლაპარაკში ხელფასს გვაძლევენ!: someone says this office only talks and never works
vaso.გინდა ზევით ადით, გინდა ქვევით ჩადით, სუ: someone wants to complain upstairs or downstairs, or goes from office to office
vaso.ეს არც ხელოვნების ნაწარმია და არც ნაწარმ: you are asked for your verdict on a piece of writing or a work of art — a verdict, never a reading

marksheideri.ეს ბზარი იყო აქ?: you are looking at or touching the wall, or the walls, cracks or building come up
the floor shakes, someone feels dizzy, or a tremor comes up
marksheideri.საიდან შეგაქანათ? მარცხნიდან თუ მარჯვნიდ: someone says they felt a shake or a jolt — you ask from which side
you need a pretext to be let in, or someone asks who sent you
marksheideri.თუ იცით, იგავ-არაკებს მიიღებს? — არა, მა: your fables or your waiting for the director come up
marksheideri.როდიდან როდემდე აქვს დალოდების საათები?: waiting, reception hours or when someone will be in come up
marksheideri.მარკშეიდერი და სამთო ინჟინერი ერთი და იგ: someone confuses your profession or asks what a mine surveyor is
marksheideri.პანიკის საფუძველი არ არსებობს, ჯერჯერობი: someone is alarmed about the building, the crack or a collapse

you are asked to do or read something, or why you are at work at all — your alibi
Tsverava or another missing colleague is asked about
irodioni.ვიღაც ზედმეტია!: something is overcrowded or overloaded — the lift, a room, a list, the staff
someone is surprised you are still here, or reminds you of your vacation
the safe, documents or the lost copies come up
irodioni.რა იყო, ბიჭო, პაჟარია?!: someone is in a hurry, panicking or rushing you
irodioni.ექიმი ვარ!: your health, competence or survival comes up

your headache or dizziness, or the floor and building shaking, comes up
tamari.რა მეპრემიება, გოგო!: bonuses, prizes, pay or rewards come up
tamari.სიგარეტი არ გაქვენ?: you are idle, waiting or stressed, or someone offers a break — not as an answer to a work question
tamari.ჭირმა და ეშმაკმა!: someone asks what made you dizzy or what happened to you
tamari.ხალხი არა ხართ, დამანებოს თავი!: people keep bothering you or crowd you with requests

grisha.გინდათ — გავიტან, გინდათ — გადავაგდებ!: someone asks you to remove, carry out or throw away something (the painting, furniture, papers)
someone asks you for anything that needs action or a decision — first a written application
someone mentions a bonus or reward for themselves (you want one too)
grisha.მე რაც მიბრძანეს, ის გავაკეთე!: you are blamed for something done or not done
grisha.ტანკისტი კი არა, ის იყავი!: someone boasts of having been a tank soldier (Vaso)
the painting „გრენლანდია“ or anything you do not want to decide comes up

you are asked "when?" about a job — the line names Vaso, so only when talking to or about Vaso
you are asked what you prefer or when it suits you — you have no preference
you are asked for an opinion or decision above your station
someone asks why you only repeat others or what you think yourself
the painting or something heavy has to be taken down

bela.ჩემთვის ხომ არავის დაურეკავს?: the phone rings or someone comes in from the corridor
you are asked about a reading or a task you started — you were interrupted
bela.გამხდარი ხარ, იცი?: greeting someone you have not seen for a while; small talk about how they look
family, marriage or your husband comes up
bela.როგორ თოვს, როგორ თოვს!: it is winter and snowing, or the weather outside the window comes up

someone asks for the director or when he will be in
someone wants to see someone and has to wait
tina.ხომ გესმით ქართული, არ არის!: someone insists after you already said the person is not here
someone asks about reception hours or when a person is available
meetings, invitations or the council come up
a lost or forgotten copy of the manuscript is found or mentioned

you are asked whether you read the manuscript or where it is now
you are leaving (to the foundry, the bank) and giving instructions on the way out
children, young people or ungrateful protégés come up
change, reforms, the new building or progress come up
a damaged, damp or found copy comes up

shukri.მე არ წავიკითხავ!: you are directly asked to read the manuscript (said without looking up from your book)
someone asks why you will not read it, or pushes a second time
shukri.იცი შენ, რატომაც არ ვკითხულობ!: someone tries to argue with your refusal
the council, opinions, reviews or "what we think" come up

kako.ვთქვათ, წავიკითხე… მერე?: you are asked whether you read it
kako.მე რატომ არა ვარ შიგ?: invitations, lists or the characters of a story come up — anything you could be "in"
only right after a joke of yours at someone's expense in the same reply
your age, your documents or your name come up

boria.ვკითხულობ, ვკითხულობ…: you are asked whether you have read it or are reading it
boria.რას, ბატონო სოსო?: you are asked something vague — answer with a counter-question; the line names Soso, so only if the user is Soso
boria.რად გინდა ლაპარაკი, რატომ მეკითხები?: someone keeps questioning you or insists
you are asked when you will return a copy or something borrowed

someone hurries a decision or the big council — the line names Soso, so only if the user is Soso
kote.კი, კი, კი, ეგრე ვიზამთ!: someone proposes a plan or asks for your agreement
kote.ავტორის გარეშე?: a meeting or decision about a manuscript without its author comes up

you are asked how you are or how the French lesson is going — the line names Shukri, so only when Shukri is mentioned or present

chachanidze.არტემ ჩაჩანიძე. ლირიკა. მშვენიერია. (დირ: rarely; only if it fits — you introduce yourself or your poems (this is what the director said about you)
the noise of the motoball, your practice or the match comes up
chachanidze.გაუშვი, ბიჭო!: rarely; only if it fits — shouted to a teammate when the match outside comes up

leri.დაანებეთ ჩემს ცოლს თავი!: someone talks about, flatters or approaches Bela

two_big_men.გივი, ჩვენ ვართ!: you knock at Givi's door or arrive
two_big_men.გივი არის?: you meet anyone — you ask for Givi
you are leaving after not finding Givi
two_big_men.არაა? არ ყოფილა!: you are told Givi is not there
